title: Exact Hausdorff gauges for SLE

result.label: Exact Hausdorff gauges for SLE
result.statement: Resolves Schramm’s Hausdorff-measure question for chordal SLE κ , 0 8. The explicit gauge r^d( (1/r))^ (2-d)/2 , d=1+ /8, gives almost surely positive finite measure to every trace segment ([s,t]) with 0 s t , and finite expected measure to the trace in every bounded disk.
